title: Random poly gatos
tagline: random poly gato is a NFT project using erc1155 token standard and chainlink VRF,
description:
random poly gato is a NFT project using erc1155 token standard and chainlink VRF,
is possible to mint cat 50 and 50 hoods, after mint is possible to do combine the cat with de hood, the project has 2600 unique NFT
